B1.name: Meteor Bash
B1.description: {{nickname}} sends heavy kicks of metal-enhanced moves against opponents, dealing [Earth] damage. The damage dealt becomes [Shield] for self equal to % of its value dealt.

stages.name: Stage 1
stages.text: Thrusts several quick fists at the opponent, dealing % of defense as damage.

stages.name: Stage 2
stages.text: Launches spheres of metal towards opponents in a line in a short point range, dealing % of defense as damage.

stages.name: Stage 3
stages.text: Slams a metal wall in front, dealing % of defense as empowered damage.

S1.name: Metal Barrier
S1.description: {{nickname}} creates a large destructible metal barrier in front of {{object}} with health and defense equal to % of {{possessive}} own defense stat for its toughness to deflect incoming attacks and endure damage. {{Subject}} then gives [Shield] equal to % of defense to self and allies.

additional.text: If [Invention] is active upon using this skill, instead, give [Shield] equal to an additional % of defense to self and allies and the metal barrier gains twice {{possessive}} defense instead. Clear a stack of [Invention].

S2.name: Rods of Steel
S2.description: Launches a large beam of steel towards opponents, dealing [Earth] empowered damage equal to % of defense. Hit opponents will gain the effect [Dazed].

additional.text: If [Invention] is active, several more beams (+3 more of them) will be shot out, dealing the same damage. Clear a stack of [Invention].

S3.name: Overloaded
S3.description: Stands still for 5 seconds to load and charge a firearm cannon, absorbing the element affinities in the party into charged shells. Once cannon is loaded, it will be a summon with health and defense equal to % of {{nickname}}’s defense stat.

additional.text: While {{nickname}} is on-field, {{subject}} can ride the cannon, gaining +50% damage reduction, and hold this skill to charge up empowered shots. When holding, a stack of [Let’m Cook] is consumed every half-second, up to a max of 6. Up to 3 of these shots can be fired. Releasing skill will trigger the following conditions:
Less than 6 stacks - Shoot a compiled bullet at aimed direction, dealing [Earth] AoE empowered damage equal to % of defense multiplied by the number of each consumed stack.

At 6 stacks - Shoot an overpowering bullet at aimed direction, dealing % of defense as a large AoE super empowered [Earth] element, and the encompassing elements of the team, damage, applying all auras at once. If [Invention] is active, consume a stack and a secondary shell is quickly fired, dealing 120% of the previous’ damage.

When {{nickname}} is off-field, the cannon will aim and periodically shoot mixed-element bullets, dealing % of defense as [Earth] damage. Cannon shoots every 2 seconds. 50% chance of the bullet being infused with one other element of the team. If a Mystical Legends ally is on-field, the interval of attack decreases to 1 second and an element is always infused.
If the skill is used while a summon is present, its health will be restored and no charging is necessary. New shells are also provided.

U1.name: Metal Mode
U1.description: {{nickname}} will encase metal armor around {{reflexive}} to gain extra defense and outward fighting power, lasting for 16 seconds.

additional.text: Upon activation, {{nickname}} will gain +100% movement speed and +20% damage reduction.

Model A: Charge forward and deal [Earth] super empowered damage equal to % of defense to any opponent in {{possessive}} path. Any skills used in conjunction with this Ultimate’s effect will deal +% more damage.

Model B: If off-field, the metal armor will dissipate and form into 2 hovering robotic turret drones that will blast energy pulses towards nearby opponents, dealing % of defense as [Earth] damage per blast.

If two or more stacks of [Invention] are active, instead, gain +50% damage reduction, +150% movement speed, and +50% skill damage for Model A. Summon an extra drone for Model B and the active character gains +30% damage reduction. Clear all stacks of [Invention].

T1.name: Ultimate Arsenal
T1.description: Ability: Upon using this skill, various effects will activate upon having varying stacks of [Invention]:

additional.text: 1 stack, gain the effect [Gamer]. 2 stacks, gain the effect [Tinkering]. 3+ stacks, turn into Special Skill: Hoverboard which may be used anytime. Stacks do not get consumed when counting and using this skill.

Special Skill: Hoverboard - {{nickname}} jumps onto a hoverboard, hovers in the air for a moment with short invulnerability, and crashes {{possessive}} way through {{possessive}} opponents, dealing 325% of attack and 275% of defense as [Fire] and [Earth] AoE damage. The damage scales by +10% for each level of the equipped Basic Skill.

Dupes.description: For every opponent hit, {{nickname}} will gain a stack of [Let'm Cook] which lasts indefinitely. {{Subject}} inflicts [Attack Down I] on nearby opponents every 5 stacks gained.

additional.text: Each stack of [Let'm Cook] will increase defense by +0.25% and gained [Shield] on self will also apply to allies as well.
{{nickname}}’s Technical Skill effects will also be applied to the party for the same duration.

Gain a [Super Shield] for self equal to 150% of defense after using any Special Skills, the effect is shared amongst the party. Whenever the Dash Skill is used, gain a stack of [Let'm Cook] (Cooldown: 2 seconds).
The inflicted debuff [Attack Down I] is enhanced to [Attack Down III] and an additional debuff [Crit Down II] is inflicted.
Increases the damage of Special Skills by +15%.

Charge energy gauge by +10% per stack of [Invention] gained. When Ultimate Skill: Metal Mode is used, each stack of [Invention] present before being cleared will increase {{nickname}}’s overall damage by an additional +30% per stack for the duration of the Ultimate.

Rapidly consuming all Dash Skills will automatically give {{nickname}} the effect [Gamer] and [Tinkering]. These effects are considered effects from a Technical Skill. Whenever either of these effects end, {{nickname}}’s Special Skill cooldowns will reset and {{subject}} gains 2 stacks of [Invention]. {{Subject}} gains twice as many stacks of [Let’m Cook].
